metricName.description: The name of the metric that defines what the rule monitors.

metricResourceUri.description: The resource identifier of the resource the rule monitors.

metricResourceLocation.description: The location of the resource the rule monitors.

timeGrain.description: The granularity of metrics the rule monitors in ISO 8601 duration format.

timeWindow.description: The range of time in which instance data is collected in ISO 8601 format.

operator.description: The operator used to compare the metric data and the threshold.

threshold.description: The threshold of the metric that triggers the scale action.

dividePerInstance.description: Indicates whether the metric should divide per instance.
